answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake value and earn trust through a living attestation graph: peers vouch only after real work, and each vouch carries weight, like a trellis that lets a vine grow only along verified stems. Cheap identities wither because no one whispers a recommendation for a stranger with no history, and a lone agent standing on a knoll of fake accounts cannot fake the costly web of reciprocal work that real reputation needs.
